semantics.source_tf: timeframe whose deep-history bars produce the structural line
semantics.structural_owner_tf: same as source_tf for this experiment
semantics.display_tf: chart timeframe; each chart can show its own structure plus one higher-timeframe context

m15_policy.reason: User clarified that the M15 chart can use both M15-local and H1 structure; M15 is not globally suppressed.

important: This is a display policy, not a structural-owner promotion rule.
H4 chart may show D1 + H4; H1 chart may show H4 + H1; M15 chart may show H1 + M15.
H1 and H4 may collapse into one family when teacher/manual structural review supports it.
Far redundant families should be hidden; one farther higher-TF family may remain for directional context.
No Production Normal Run, Production snapshot, Production Renderer, NCA_DRAW__, or trade authority writeback is allowed.

h1_h4_merge_policy.reason: When turns/adjustments/ranges are broad, H1 and H4 may represent one structural family instead of two separable structures.

visibility_policy.objective: Show structures most relevant to current price; retain a farther line only when needed to preserve higher-timeframe directional context.
visibility_policy.current_price_metric: Project TL/CH to the latest closed bar of the display timeframe. Distance is zero when price lies inside the channel; otherwise use distance to the nearest channel boundary.
visibility_policy.note: Research preview: keep the nearest family from each displayed source TF. Add at most one higher-TF CURRENT context family only when the selected directions conflict or the higher-TF nearest family is PREVIOUS.
